summary: Drum & bass: 165–180 BPM two-step breakbeats, heavy sub or reese bass, pads or stabs, felt at half speed
body: Drums: the two-step (kick 1 and the and of 3, snare 2 and 4) or chopped breaks; ghost snares and shakers keep the 16ths moving.
Bass: a deep sub or a detuned 'reese', long notes, in half-time against the drums.
Harmony: liquid DnB uses lush minor 7th/9th pads and Rhodes; jump-up and neuro have almost none.
Feel: the pads and bass at half speed, the drums at full speed.

Apply: pattern/dnb-two-step on the drums, then pattern/prog-drum-and-bass-common-1 on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 165–180 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
